'''Varno Market''' was a [[market]]place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vengler]]. Around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], a group of [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] came across the [[Eye of Koda]] in the marketplace, and were attacked by [[Scitrok Warriors]] under the command of [[Dhar Bullwin]].
